other_conditions: Applicant should be IT‑savvy and able to prepare and upload reports/documentation of youth programmes.
Applicant should be familiar with preparing reports for media or news statements.
Applicant must know how to use required mobile apps such as DigiDhan, Digital India, etc.
benefits_summary: An honorarium of ₹5,000 per month is provided for up to two years of full‑time service.
